searchText: So one topic regarding code Merklization that could be interesting In addition to adding a Merkle root of code to the account object, we can add a Kate commitment to code See https://dankradfeist.de/ethereum/2020/06/16/kate-polynomial-commitments.html on Kate commitments The powerful advantage of Kate commitments is that you can make an O(1) sized witness (really! just 48 bytes) for an arbitrary, even non-contiguous, subset of the code They do require a trusted setup, which is why I would favor adding them in addition to Merkle roots, so clients can choose which type of witness they want I'd be happy to work with anyone who wants to experiment on kate commitments for code merkleization I'm interested too ...though still reading about it...
